claims.claim: This sewing machine is in a very good condition, just buy and use.
claims.evidence: The report only shows the exterior (white Singer-looking machine, pedal, and a small attachment). No test run, stitching result, or internal/motor condition is shown.

risks.risk: It may not power on or may not stitch properly (motor/drive or timing issue).
risks.proof: A short video of powering on and a test stitch on fabric (showing feed, straight seam, and consistent stitch formation).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used sewing machine with unknown working condition (assume needs testing/possible service).

risks.risk: Foot pedal or power cable may be incomplete or faulty.
risks.proof: A clip showing the pedal controlling speed while the machine runs (and that the power cable is present and intact).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if pedal/power function is not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories (bobbin case, bobbins, needles, presser feet, thread guides) not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo/video inventory of all included parts: bobbins, needle(s), presser feet set, bobbin case, power cable, and any manuals/attachments.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete accessories (only what’s shown/confirmed).

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear (cracks, rust, bent needle bar, worn gears) not visible externally.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, feed dogs, belt/gears area (if accessible), and any underside/hinges; plus a sound check during operation.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic/functional wear for a used unit.

risks.risk: Exact model/serial number not confirmed; value can vary widely by model and age.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model plate/serial label (or any markings) and the full machine nameplate.
risks.if_unproven: Price without model certainty (use the lowest-value Singer-class assumption).

proof_requests: Send a video of the machine powering on and stitching a short line on fabric (show feed and stitch consistency).
Show the pedal controlling speed while stitching (include the power cable connection).
Provide a complete photo/video inventory of included accessories: bobbins, needle(s), presser feet, bobbin case, and any other attachments.
Send close-up photos of the needle/plate area and feed dogs, plus any visible underside/gear/belt area if accessible.
Send a clear photo of the model/serial label on the machine body.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies it as a Singer-branded sewing machine with a pedal and at least one attachment, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. However, working performance and completeness are not proven, so the price should reflect unknown functionality until tested.
